summary: Iteration 5 (Regional-language drafts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 relevant pytest cases pass — GET /api/languages returns all 6 languages; POST /api/templates/translate returns Devanagari/Tamil/Telugu/Bengali/Marathi text for all 5 non-English languages with proper nouns ('ABC Tech Pvt Ltd', 'XYZ Analytics LLP', '35000', '138') preserved verbatim in every translation; English target echoes input; unsupported language → 400; text < 10 chars → 400; unauthenticated → 401. POST /api/templates/docx-from-text produces a valid python-docx-openable file (>=5KB), Content-Disposition filename includes language suffix (e.g. 'Mutual-NDA-Hindi.docx'), title paragraph is suffixed with '— Hindi' for non-English (and NOT for English). Missing text → 400. Frontend: TemplateModal shows the new lang-tabs bar with all 6 buttons (lang-english active by default, lang-hindi/tamil/telugu/bengali/marathi). Clicking lang-hindi calls /api/templates/translate exactly once and swaps template-output to Devanagari text. Switching back to lang-english and again to lang-hindi issues ZERO additional translate calls (client cache verified). Download DOCX while Hindi active hits /api/templates/docx-from-text (not /templates/nda-mutual/docx) and filename is 'nda-mutual-hindi.docx'. Share button while Hindi active POSTs to /api/templates/share.

issues: When lang-hindi is active, the pill has bg=var(--nm-ink) with text-white — the 'हिंदी · Hindi' label appears very hard to see in screenshots (possibly Noto Sans Devanagari not applied to the white-on-dark variant, or the chip height clips it). Text is present in the DOM (textContent='हिंदी· Hindi') so functionally OK, but the active-state contrast/rendering for Devanagari native script should be verified visually. Non-active pills render Devanagari (मराठी) fine.

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: Verify active lang-tab renders 'हिंदी · Hindi' clearly (font-family: 'Noto Sans Devanagari' on the .nm-chip active state; ensure the chip has enough vertical padding for Indic descenders).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown past 2000 lines — consider splitting Templates / Translation into a router module.

SYS_TRANSLATE prompt correctly instructs verbatim preservation of proper nouns, amounts and statute names; test_translate_indic_language verifies all 5 languages keep 'ABC Tech Pvt Ltd', 'XYZ Analytics LLP', '35000' and '138' verbatim.
docx-from-text properly rejects empty/whitespace text (400) and suffixes filename with the language label; safe filename regex strips unsafe chars.
Frontend switchLang() correctly caches per language in state and skips network for cached / english; regenerate() resets translations and lang — verified by code review.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per-run at trans<ts>@nyaya.in / pass1234 and uitrans<ts>@nyaya.in / pass1234.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Templates library route is /app/templates (App shell). Template cards use data-testid='template-<slug>' (NOT 'template-card-<slug>'). Modal input fields use 'tf-<field_key>'. Language tabs use 'lang-<code>'. Translation endpoint may take 5-15s per language — use generous (60-90s) timeouts. Client cache is state-based so it only survives while modal is open; regenerating clears it (verified in code, not in a runtime test).
